The first lowcase brew

El Pescador

Coastal Lager

First cast. First sip.

ABV
4.8%
IBU
20

The beer that launched lowcase Brewing started with a plan for a light, crisp pilsner. German Pilsner and Vienna malts, paired with Hallertau Mittelfrüh hops, took us somewhere a little more golden and delightfully malt-forward.

El Pescador became a family favorite—and one we look forward to brewing regularly. It belongs with fishing days, friends and family, and the gathering around the grill or fish fry afterward.
